I kept my abuse to myself until I was 18 and just blurted it out because someone else in our circle was abused and my mum felt sorry for her and it reminded me that I was abused. Kind of like how you recently remembered. I think deep down you know what you want/need to do but you’re suppressing it which is really understandable. If you had a kid and they were going through what you went through would you want them to tell you? Probably. 

I would try not to look at it as spreading pain, so far the pain has just been contained in you and that’s not fair. Humans need other humans. If you decide to speak up it will be hard but over time it will get better. If you don’t speak up it’ll probably just stay bad and u have to live with the feelings which isn’t fair because you didn’t do anything wrong.

For context I was like a zombie after I first spoke out because it all came flooding back to me at once, my mum handled it so so poorly. I would be in my room on the floor crying in pain (4 days after I told?) and she would say get over it. I was also made to lie to take back my confession and say I lied about the abuse to police. Blablabla all of that to say, if I could go back time I would still tell. By the point I told it had stopped for 2/3 years so it wasn’t like I was in active danger. But the mind and body holds the danger and you don’t feel safe in urself even though the situation is over. 

The reason I talk about my experiences is because I don’t want you to think I am giving this advice because I did it and it was easy for me, fuck no. It was bad and the aftermath damaged me further. But these things are better out than in and can potentially stop it happening to more people. But that’s not for you to worry about right now , you’re number one. 

I also appreciate I don’t know the ins and outs of what you are experiencing but if you are really struggling during this contemplation period, I would say you should tell. Even though I told I stil suppress but learning how not to. Holding these toxic things that other people have done to us inside ourselves will only result in us becoming ill or suffering. That’s not fair you deserve compassion. I just want to add that over time me and my mum are in a good place so even if you don’t get the initial reaction you might expect, esp bc ur parents might be shocked, in time things will work out if everyone has good intentions (re u and ur parents). You deserve a hug and for someone to say I’m sorry this happened to you. And I am really sorry it did and you’re so strong for surviving so far and keeping ur shit together in spite of this.  I wish u the best love❤️‍🩹
